name: cortico-world-browser
description: Cortico World: 浏览器 —— 她能搜索、开页、读页、点击、填表、上传、截图，也能陪看 B 站视频（画面拼图、字幕与弹幕），共用浏览器与登录态。★ 非即插即用：装完包还不能用，要先装上游 web-access，填 worlds.browser.skillDir、选浏览器并打开远程调试，否则 World 起不来。要求 Cortico 0.2.0 及以上。 ★ 支持 Coopanion(Coo):0.2.5 上实测通过。有问题请提 GitHub issue,或到 QQ 群 @筆離嘢。

en.description: Cortico World: a managed browser the bot can search, open, read, click, fill, upload and screenshot, plus Bilibili video watching with frame mosaics, subtitles and danmaku. ★ Not plug-and-play: installing the package is not enough. Install the upstream web-access project first, set worlds.browser.skillDir, pick the browser and enable its remote debugging, or the World will not start. Requires Cortico 0.2.0 or later. ★ Runs in Coopanion (Coo): installed and verified on Coopanion 0.2.5. Problems: open an issue on GitHub, or ping @筆離嘢 in the QQ group (same name as the author).

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test
